title: JIT budget compliance check
objective: Verify all contraction plans are within JIT budget limits (512/2000/5000).
risks: Budget regressions can appear without visible solver failures, so the failing contraction still needs manual localization if the optimizer heuristics changed late in the sprint.
The JIT budget thresholds are intentionally strict; seemingly harmless emitter or optimizer expansions can push a contraction over a limit without changing numerical outputs.
completion_notes: Verified that the MVP contraction plans stay within the documented per-function, per-kernel, and absolute JIT budgets.
